verdict: Yes, if you can nail fit. Freakins pitched fashionable denim on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Denim is a large, steady category, but fit problems drive high returns, and fabric costs are higher than for T-shirts.
angle: Denim buyers stay loyal once a brand fits them. Young buyers want trend-led cuts such as baggy, wide-leg and cargo that big brands are slow to add. Clusters in Ahmedabad, Delhi and Bengaluru supply fabric and washing. Fit and wash consistency are where most small denim brands fail.
